test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boxes C, D, E, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only D is kept above N. Only two boxes are kept between N and O. Only P is kept below C. E is not kept immediately above O.

How many boxes are kept between M and P?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes, C, D, E, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only D is kept above N.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between N and O.
 
• Only P is kept below C.
 
• E is not kept immediately above O.

 

The final Arrangement is

 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
P

 
 
 

 

Two boxes are kept between M and P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
